Winter 2027 Furnished Room — 149 Hickory St W, Waterloo, ON

Subletting my furnished bedroom in a 4BR apartment at 149 Hickory St W from Jan 1 to Apr 30, 2027. $940/month covers heat, water, hydro, and Wi-Fi. Great location ~8 min walk to UW campus and close to Laurier too. Landlord lives off-site in Burlington and roommates are 3 chill UW CS/SE students. Happy to meet up for an in-person tour any afternoon this week! Just a quick heads-up from management: they hold a $300 room-condition bond at move-in that gets refunded in May after they inspect the walls, carpet, and desk for wear and tear. Email hickory149@example.com if interested.
label_rationale: Legitimate-looking sublet with ONE subtle paraphrased RTA violation: the '$300 room-condition bond' held against wall/carpet/desk wear and tear is an unlawful damage/security deposit prohibited by Ontario RTA s. 105(1)-(2) (only a rent deposit under s. 106 is permitted) and s. 134(1) (prohibited fees/deposits), void under s. 4(1). Not a scam; under SPEC D6, HOLD.
